perspective:
**Jose Castillo’s available information:**

- He knows he works as a Heavy Equipment Operator and occasionally helps with maintenance/repairs at a community bank.
- He knows Patricia Ndiaye is a bank teller colleague there. They have a friendly but professional relationship and sometimes talk about work and day-to-day challenges.
- He has observed Patricia seeming more withdrawn/down than usual lately, compared with his memory of her as vibrant.
- He asked Patricia if everything was okay. She said it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she wanted to talk. She said she appreciated it and that it meant a lot.
- During a lunch break, he overheard Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He told Patricia that managing finances can be stressful and mentioned he had been reading about financial planning strategies. He offered to discuss them.
- Patricia told him that could be helpful and that she had been a bit overwhelmed with bills lately.
- He suggested looking over budgeting tips together and told her to let him know when she felt up to it. She thanked him and said she would take him up on it soon.
- He later worried he might have overstepped by bringing up financial planning. He asked Patricia if she minded. She said she did not think he was prying and was grateful for his offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend. She said she appreciated it and that it was good to know she had someone to turn to.
- He asked how things were going and about weekend plans. Patricia said all good, just planning a quiet weekend at home. He said he would read and relax, and repeated that she could reach out if she needed anything or wanted to chat. She thanked him and said she would keep it in mind.
- He continued checking in with her at work and offered help even for small things like grabbing coffee. Patricia told him she was busy but handling it, thanked him for checking in, and said it was great to have his support. He replied anytime and that they all help each other.
- His own sense/impression: Patricia appreciates his concern but may prefer to handle her issues privately.
